## Outcome
Done: `formatReceipt` is added to `src/money.ts`, and `formatCents` is fixed so the spec examples hold.

- `src/money.ts`: `formatCents` now handles negatives (sign before the dollar sign) and zero-pads cents to two digits. The old version gave `$1.5` for 105 and `$-3.-50` for -250.

Ran the spec examples through the module with node: all four `formatCents` cases and both `formatReceipt` cases (the Tea/Refund example and the empty list) match. `git status` shows only `src/money.ts` modified.
